title: Levels section heading
description: A small wide-tracked grey capital eyebrow, a medium-weight, tightly tracked grotesk title (32px on phones with an open 1.5 line height, 56px and tight on desktop) and a warm grey lead; left-aligned or centred, with smaller row and larger display sizes and a pale sage eyebrow for dark bands.
notes: the lead is capped near 760px wide
